title: Quadzilla-squat plateau breaker
author: Brady V.
desc:
3 squat focused days ,2 lower 1 full,and a 4th upper body day,designed to get you bigger and stronger primarily through boosting your squat up and adding development to your lagging leg development,great for gym enthusiasts that want a stronger squat,solid for off season powerlifters,and solid for grapplers that need stronger legs for their next tournament
CALORIC SURPLUS HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

ex.note: Warm up as necessary first day you’re going to start with a Super Squats style method LP,20 rep max deep breathing squats add 5 pounds each week
Follow a dynamic double progression,full rom is critical and a slow eccentric
Blast these hard with perfect technique,linear progression or myo reps instead if you prefer
2 sets amrap short rest go until technical failure
3 amraps get as close to failure as you can without losing too much technique
Percentage is just a rough estimate and guideline doesn’t have to be exact and it’s just a start point,DYNAMIC DOUBLE PROGRESSION
Dynamic double progression,do these somewhere in between a pendlay and reach style row,push hard with minimal technique change
Typical linear progression,strict technique,push these pretty heavy
Add reps each week then proceed to add weight,deep stretch and short pause
Full rotation and extension,controlled tempo
Start off around 75% for 3x5+ every 2 reps  over 5 you get on third set is 5 pounds the next week
Dynamic double progression
First 2 sets heavily strict,3rd set use a slight bit of momentum but very minimal,dynamic double progression
2 count pause at top,stretch all the way at bottom on on first 2 sets,3rd set move explosive but not sloppy,dynamic double progression
Try to beat the books each with either reps,weight,or both
Same rules as dips
2 count pause at bottom,ideally heels elevated or Olympic shoes if you have them,dynamic double progression,work the hell out of the quads
Do these paused,from a deficit, and reach style,dynamic double progression or LP if you prefer
This should exhaust you,2 minutes of the heaviest you can handle with perfect form
Stimulate don’t annihilate
